amino acid deprivation in Escherichica coli results in a rapid turnover of ribosomal and possibly transfer RNA.
the net rate of rRNA synthesis in starved cells is 1.8%, the rate of synthesis is either 64 or 165% and the percentage of nasient RNA that is rRNA or tRNA is either 34 or 25%.
the rate of synthesis and the fraction of total nascent RNA which are ribosomal and transfer in growing and starved E. coli are 45% and 34%, respectively, and 64% and 25%, respectively.

there are two types of RNA synthesis in bacteria: net and nascent RNA synthesis.
